title: Celigo-based cell-counting and viability assay for mammalian cells
protocol: Make the staining solution with 8 µM Hoechst and 0.4 µg/mL PI in complete media (CD CHO + 8 mM L-Glutamine).
Pipette 3 μL of cell suspension into each well of a 96-well plate.
Add 200 μL of the staining solution to each well.
Mix by pipetting up and down three times in each well.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 40 minutes.
Scan wells on the Celigo using the mask (blue channel; Hoechst) and target 1 (red channel; PI).
Use fixed exposure time and gain settings for the red channel.
Set a fixed gate to distinguish PI-positive and negative cells.
Include healthy cells in one well to correctly set the PI-gate.
